newsitem.title: INDIA: India sees 97/98 net same as 96/97.
newsitem.headline: India sees 97/98 net same as 96/97.

text.p: India's state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corp (ONGC) said on Friday it expects net profit in 1997/98 (April-March) to be about the same as in 1996/97, when it was 19.75 billion rupees.
"We expect the net profit in the current financial year to be hovering at about the same level as last year," an ONGC spokesman told Reuters.
He said 1997/98 crude oil output was expected to be about 27.8 million tonnes, compared with 28.7 million in 1996/97.
The spokesman did not give reasons for the anticipated fall in output but said "it was a realistic target".
